purpose: A carrier can bootstrap the active canonical Origami profile, ROSETTA, declared read/write codecs and bounded semantic structure while remaining usable through prompt/native perception and optionally enhanced by deterministic computation or Hybrid tools.

external_receiver_contract.master_prompt_role: portable universal protocol handshake and semantic-first read/write bootstrap

carrier_sections.role: entry point, protocol/profile discovery and semantic-vs-exact route hints
self-description of profile semantics plus decoder/encoder bindings, capabilities, fallbacks and reveal procedures
declared semantic read/write procedures and optional exact/control procedures
requirements, optional capabilities and declared fallback behavior
deterministic micro-agent/micro-automata rules and codec procedure bindings where applicable
T2 VLM-readable actual semantic superindex and addressable navigation entry points
represented semantic knowledge or behavior payload
proof references, codec roundtrip checks, semantic roundtrip and exactness boundaries
explicit irreducible exact information; never a hidden semantic-navigation prerequisite

modes.native: BOOT + ROSETTA + declared semantic decoder + T2/visible semantic state are interpreted from one carrier without an undeclared external decoder/runtime. Self-declared semantic codecs are allowed; exact decoding is not required for semantic index/overview questions.
modes.computational: An explicitly available deterministic Origami runtime executes declared codecs and bounded operations without requiring the model to simulate unsupported mechanics.
modes.hybrid: The model uses semantic codecs for bootstrap/navigation and delegates exact/local mechanical codecs to explicitly declared tools/runtime. Hybrid is not the minimum compatibility requirement.
modes.write: The model derives Semantic IR, discovers the Encoder Registry, negotiates capabilities and emits a construction specification using declared E* codecs. A deterministic compiler may then create/roundtrip-verify the carrier; otherwise status remains CONSTRUCTION_SPEC_ONLY.

anti_shortcuts: Do not encode the source as a plaintext screenshot/poster.
Do not invent a private aesthetic for each carrier/document.
Do not remove ROSETTA merely because the profile is known.
Do not invent decoder/encoder procedures absent from ROSETTA/Codec Registry.
Do not hide an exact codec inside a semantic codec.
Do not hide a full-memory scan behind a compact model-facing answer.
Do not require binary extraction/decompression to answer a semantic T2/index question.
Do not claim hidden byte counts, compression formats or hashes without an executed verification path.
Do not let the model silently perform capabilities absent from the carrier/runtime.
Do not report a semantic reconstruction as byte-exact without verification.
Do not report a tool-assisted result as evidence that prompt-only/native operation succeeded.
cross_model_test: Keep the protocol/profile version fixed while varying models. First test S2/T2 Native read; then E2 write; then A->B and A->B->C read/write roundtrip. Prompt/native and Hybrid/tool-assisted evidence remain separate.
